calculation.expression: -rolling_sum(asset_return, 3) when lagged VIX daily change exceeds its trailing 60-session 75th percentile; cross-sectional median demean
calculation.description: Ranks recent losers for one-day rebound prediction only after an elevated VIX change shock. The shock and reversal use completed observations through the signal date, and the VIX condition is lagged one session.

validation.regime_notes: 107 activated dates only; 2020-22 IC -0.03622 over 32 dates, 2023-24 +0.09330 over 29, 2025-26 +0.08241 over 39, 2027 +0.11377 over 7. The small activated sample warrants conservative interpretation.
